capabilities: Display a GitHub or local Git contribution heatmap in the sidebar
Connect to GitHub via OAuth or a personal access token
Scan local folders for git repositories and read commit history
Track contribution totals and current/best streaks
Open or create the matching daily note from any heatmap cell
extras: Local Git mode runs git log locally and sends no data; the plugin states it has no analytics, tracking, or telemetry, and GitHub tokens are stored locally and used only for the GitHub GraphQL API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view your coding contribution history from GitHub or local repositories alongside your notes.

relations.evidence: OAuth authentication - connect GitHub with one click, no token copying required
Works alongside the core Daily Notes and Periodic Notes plugins

summary: Sidebar panel that shows GitHub and local Git contribution heatmaps with streak stats and click-through daily note creation.
